dedupe_keys.name: nyc local law 84 building energy and water benchmarking disclosure

description: New York City's Local Law 84 of 2009 requires owners of buildings over 50,000 square feet to submit annual energy and water benchmarking data, collected through the EPA's ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager, and the city publishes the results on NYC Open Data. The current table covers calendar year 2022 onward, with 265 columns; each property has its EPA property ID and may cover several tax lots (BBLs) or buildings (BINs). Separate tables hold disclosures for each calendar year from 2010 to 2021, monthly LL84 data, and Local Law 87 energy audit data. Coverage: large buildings in New York City. Access: CSV, JSON and Socrata API downloads. Licence: NYC Open Data terms; free. Caveats: data are self-reported by owners through Portfolio Manager and include errors and outliers, and column sets changed between years. Simulation uses are city building stock energy baselines, calibration of urban building energy models and tracking emissions policy such as Local Law 97. Related records: PLUTO, which joins by BBL, the Seattle benchmarking data and ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager.
